expires_today.title: Complete Homeschooling Coding, AI & Game Dev Bundle
expires_today.description: Homeschool technology courses for curious teens.
expires_today.long_description:
Give your middle or high school learner practical technology skills through 33 hands-on, project-based courses from Zenva. Students build confidence with coding, game development, web development, cybersecurity, digital literacy, and creative technology while creating real projects and developing problem-solving skills.

Learners progress from beginner-friendly coding into web development, Python programming, game development with industry-standard engines, 3D modeling, and essential digital literacy topics like networking, data, privacy, cybersecurity, and the core concepts behind modern computing through guided, practical lessons.

Pay what you want for this collection from Zenva, support Alzheimer's Research UK, and give your homeschool learner a strong foundation for future study, creative projects, and confidence with technology.

Keys Expire. Please redeem before September 2nd, 2027.

expires_today.title: Godzilla: Kaiju Rampage by IDW
expires_today.long_description:
Brace yourself for a kaiju-sized bundle of Godzilla comics from IDW Publishing! You’ve seen the King of the Monsters on the big screen, and now’s the time to find him in the pages of these fantastic comics. Dive into the biggest and best Godzilla stories in the Deluxe Edition of Godzilla’s 70th Anniversary! Witness the giant lizard’s comic evolution in Godzilla: The Monster Comic Art Collection! Have a little fun with offbeat favorites like Godzilla: Skate or Die and Starship Godzilla [Kai-Sei Era]: First Wars! And of course we had to include Earth’s mightiest protector in Godzilla Legends—Mothra: Queen of the Monsters! Titan adventures and more await in what we might as well call the King of the Bundles, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support Make-A-Wish Foundation with your purchase!

The titles in this bundle are available through Kobo.com. To access the content, create or log in to your Kobo.com account.

expires_today.title: The Ultimate Ollama and Local AI Bundle
expires_today.description: Oh là là for Ollama & Local AI
expires_today.long_description:
Speed up your development time with The Ultimate Ollama and Local AI Bundle. Unlock unlimited reps with Ollama, the easiest way to automate your work using open models while keeping your data safe. Or learn how to use LocalAI, the AI model that runs directly on your own local hardware. Pay what you want for elite learning courses like Automate with Kimi, Local AI Workflows with Codex and Ollama, Natural-Language SQL Generation with Python and Ollama, and more—the right tools are only a bundle away!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before August 24th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Humanoids Megabundle: Universes Unbound, Part 2 by Humanoids
expires_tomorrow.description: Worlds of adventure in these comics
expires_tomorrow.long_description: It’s no secret that Humanoids has long been one of the most exciting and unique publishers of comics for decades, and now you can add even more of their best stuff to your digital library! This new bundle in partnership with Humanoids features Shakespearean space operas, dystopian action-adventures, supernatural urban fantasies, and more! Rock out with the witches of Black Cat Social Club as they fight corporate demons and slay their gigs! Dive deeper into the legend Alejandro Jodorowsky’s worlds with Megalex and The Incal spinoff The Metabarons! Follow an orphaned boy with powers over the weather on his quest to find out the truth about his family in Child of the Storm! All this and more is included in this giant bundle of 40 fantastic comic series, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support children’s reading charity Reading Is Fundamental with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Blades, Blasters & Beasts
expires_tomorrow.description: Unlock badass blades, blasters, and beasts!
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Looking for new and exciting assets to spice up your next project? We’ve assembled a badass collection of action assets to deliver hundreds of unique options that bring life to your next round of character creation or development of bombastic action set pieces. Pay what you want for thoroughly fleshed-out NPC assets to fill your battlefields, customize Viking warriors with countless designs to choose from, or take your fun to the stars and develop your own sci-fi characters. Unlock 75+ professional-quality asset packs and help support ComicBooks for Kids with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before July 13, 2028.
Professional Fab Marketplace keys provided.

expires_tomorrow.title: Indie's Support for Venezuela Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: Support indie devs and disaster relief!
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
The recent earthquakes in Venezuela have left communities facing an urgent humanitarian crisis. We’ve teamed up with indie developers from Venezuela and around the world to assemble a collection of great games in support of relief efforts, helping provide critical aid to those affected. To better aid with Direct Relief's impact in providing assistance in the wake of these earthquakes, our developer partners have agreed to increase standard charity share for this bundle.

Build a cozy home in space for a furry-tailed friend in The Last Cat in the Universe, complete with the Supporter Pack DLC. Or try Calico, the adorable LGBTQ+-positive story of rebuilding a local cat cafe, and 10+ additional acclaimed indie titles!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 2nd, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Handsome Husbandos
expires_tomorrow.description: Build your dream life with your dream man
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

We’re not saying your future husband is definitely living inside a video game… but you might want to grab this bundle of otome games juuust in case! We’ve selected our favorite visual novels in a variety of genres, all fully customizable so you can achieve the unforgettable adventure and heartstopping romance of your dreams. Train as a warrior and navigate the complex and deadly ninja politics of Nightshade! Fall in love in the industrial Depths of the dystopian steampunk world of Steam Prison! Grow up alongside the boy of your dreams in the seaside summer town of Our Life: Beginnings & Always, which includes the full DLC pack! There’s even more excitement and romance to be found in the visual novels in this bundle, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Breakthrough T1D with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 2nd, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The BattleTech RPG Collection Encore by Catalyst Game Labs
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Blast off to the stars and beyond with BattleTech! This sci-fi tabletop RPG sets players down in the middle of a space opera of epic proportions, where empires rise and fall and the future of humanity rests on your shoulders. This bundle of BattleTech ebooks from Catalyst Game Labs is full of guides, rulebooks, and storylines to put you and your party on the path to universal domination! Immerse yourself in the rich lore of the galaxy, pick which faction you’ll represent in the looming conflict, hop inside a BattleMech, and choose from a vast array of combat zones in which to test your mettle. Enter a universe of possibility with this BattleTech bundle—grab it now at the price of your choice, and support Gamers Outreach with your purchase!

Codes are redeemable through the DriveThruRPG website.

expires_within_72h.title: Complete Design Studio
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Turn your imagination and inspiration into a thoughtful blueprint for your home’s future this summer with the ultimate home design bundle from Richdale Ventures! Unlock professional-grade personal CAD software that helps you reimagine every inch of your property, from the bathroom to the backyard. Save big on ArchiMaster 3D, the hottest home-design platform, before this amazing deal disappears, and help support the American Cancer Society with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before December 31st, 2026.

expires_within_72h.title: The EC Comics Artists Library by Fantagraphics
expires_within_72h.description: Celebrate the art of these fantastic comics
expires_within_72h.long_description: Comics need great writers, sure, but they’d be nothing without the talented artists who put their blood, sweat, and tears into bringing these stories to life on the page. Our latest bundle in partnership with Fantagraphics celebrates the iconic artists behind EC Comics’ greatest hits! See the world of Ray Bradbury’s short stories like never before in Home to Stay! The Complete Ray Bradbury EC Stories illustrated by the likes of Reed Crandall, Frank Frazetta, Al Williamson, Wallace Wood, and more! Dive into the work of your favorite artists in collections like Jack Kamen’s Kamen’s Kalamity, Harvey Kurtzman’s Man and Superman, Jack Davis’ ’Taint the Meat… It’s The Humanity!, and Reed Crandall’s The High Cost of Dying. Get 40 collections highlighting EC Comics’ greatest artists for the price of your choice, and support Freedom to Read Foundation with your purchase!
